scores.reasons: Gap: booking and pricing are already strong via Booksy, so the gap is ownership - no site, no hours or phone in text, no schema. Pay: four working barbers with 159 reviews at 4.9 is a healthier shop than the other barbers here, though tickets are $20-45. Ease: a one-page site plus a schema block is quick. Evidence: opened the live Booksy profile and read services, prices, staff and reviews; no owned site exists to inspect.

caveats: Google Search and Google Maps returned a CAPTCHA/'unusual traffic' block in the browser, so star ratings and review counts come from directories that mirror Google reviews (Birdeye, BestProsInTown, SalonLookup, Booksy) rather than from Google directly; counts differ between mirrors.
Hours posted on business websites and on directory mirrors disagreed in several cases; both are reported where seen.

Scores are relative to this batch (small Middlesex County hair/beauty/barber businesses), not to the wider market. Businesses with no website score low on evidence because there is little owned material to inspect.

Roma Beauty Salon's North Brunswick branch is treated as operating because the live five-location site lists it with its own phone number; branch hours and reviews specific to that branch were not separately verified.
